summary: Clear package pricing and a WhatsApp number are strengths, but missing images, dead menu items and a pricing error appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The Departments, Services and Packages and Benefits menu items link to #, and the social icons use javascript:void(0).
findings.cost: Visitors cannot open the sections they came for.
findings.fix: Working menus and real social links.

findings.problem: Every image appears to use the same blank placeholder, so treatment photos such as Laser Hair Removal show no picture.
findings.cost: A page with no images looks unfinished and sells poorly.

findings.problem: One bundle reads 4 Sessions Each Qr.1,500 Save Qr.500 while the listed prices add up to Qr.1,700, a saving of Qr.200.
findings.cost: A pricing error invites doubt about every offer.

findings.problem: The footer logo is labelled Medidove, the Live Chat heading shows no chat, three headlines are cut off and the WhatsApp link is written two ways.
findings.cost: Leftovers and broken details make a medical brand look careless.
findings.fix: A clean page with a working chat button.

redesign: Working menus and real treatment photos.
One verified price list with clear packages.
A working chat and WhatsApp button on every page.
